form.label: Sightings
form.description: Vehicles visitors logged after a lookup: where, and what car. Sightings of plates the site couldn't name are filed under UNKNOWN and feed the research queue.

search.query: `ptf_events` event_type="sighting" | `ptf_plate_parts` | `ptf_country_name` | fields _time plate code country city state vehicle_make vehicle_model vehicle_color user anonymous src_ip_hash
| eval kind=if(upper(country)=="UNKNOWN", "Unknown plate", "Known plate") | timechart count BY kind

| sort 0 -_time | eval seen=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), spotter=if(isnotnull(user), user, "Anonymous") | table seen plate code country city state vehicle_make vehicle_model vehicle_color spotter | rename seen AS Seen, plate AS Plate, code AS Code, country AS Country, city AS City, state AS State, vehicle_make AS Make, vehicle_model AS Model, vehicle_color AS Color, spotter AS Spotter

| eval vehicle_make=coalesce(vehicle_make, "Not given"), vehicle_model=coalesce(vehicle_model, "-") | stats count AS Sightings dc(plate) AS Plates BY vehicle_make vehicle_model | sort 10 -Sightings | rename vehicle_make AS Make, vehicle_model AS Model
| eval city=coalesce(city, "Not given"), state=coalesce(state, "-") | stats count AS Sightings dc(plate) AS Plates BY city state | sort 10 -Sightings | rename city AS City, state AS State
